text:
Until you die, brave youth,
dying and surrendering were one thing;
now there will be two, for the first corpse
dies yet does not rest.


You alone, after your setting,
leave Death, attentive and dutiful,
so suspended that she wonders, afraid,
whether you or she suffers the stroke.


Whose courage, I ask, lasted longer than life?
Who deserved death?
Or was he envied as uncertain dust?


O unheard-of foresight of fate,
which reserves you for this new matter:
to be immortal after you are dead!

translation.title: Until You Die, Brave Youth
